create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that enforces a specific type when setting values on a class
create_ManagedAttribute_without_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that allows any type when setting values on a class
test_ManagedAttribute_get: test the ManagedAttribute descriptor __get__ method to retrieve a private attribute value from an object
test_ManagedAttribute_set: test the ManagedAttribute descriptor __set__ method to set a value with optional type enforcement
review_ManagedAttribute_set_name: review the ManagedAttribute __set_name__ method that maps public attribute names to private underscore-prefixed names
